title: Orcas Island Eclipse Charters
blurb: Guests join high-speed vessels with experienced captains and naturalist guides to watch whales and other wildlife in the San Juan Islands. Tours depart from Anacortes, Lopez Island, and Orcas Island. Kayaking tours and rentals are also available, including bioluminescence and coastal tours.
extraNote: March 1 to November 15 for whale tours; May 1 to September 30 for Orca Only tours
season: March 1 to November 15 for whale tours; May 1 to September 30 for Orca Only tours
